<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="ex37012023-09-11-145230">
         <milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (225a2-225a7)"/>
        <lb n="225a2"/> <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4728">'dul ba mdo'i rnam bshad mdo'i nyi ma'i rgyan</rs> zhes <lb n="225a3"/> bya ba 'di ni | 'dul ba 'dzin pa stan 1 pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4311">nam_mkha' rin chen</rs> dang | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">lung riGS smra ba  <!--grub pa seng ge ???-->grub pa seng ge</rs> | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593"><!--dpal ldan seng ge ???-->dka' bcu 'dzin pa <abbr>dpal ldan</abbr> seng ge</rs> | 
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593"><!--byang chub dpal ???-->'dul ba 'dzin pa byang chub dpal</rs> la <abbr>sogs pa</abbr> don du gnyer <abbr>ba'i</abbr> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593">slob ma rnams</rs> kyi bskul <abbr>ba'i</abbr> ngor ¦ mkhyen rabs <lb n="225a4"/> dang <abbr>thugs rje</abbr>'i mnga' bdag lhar bcas 'gro ba kun gyi <abbr>gtsug gi</abbr> <abbr>nor bu</abbr> <abbr>mkhan chen</abbr> <abbr>rin po che'i</abbr> <abbr>byin gyis</abbr> brlabs shing 'dul ba 'buM sde'i mnga' bdag 'dul ba 'dzin pa<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4003"> dmar ston <abbr>dpal ldan</abbr> rin chen <?oxy_comment_start comment="P10033?"?><?oxy_comment_end?></rs> dang ¦  <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4004">'dul ba 'dzin pa <abbr>nam mkha'</abbr> rgyal mtshan<?oxy_comment_start comment="P71?"?><?oxy_comment_end?>gyi</rs> sku drin la [b]rten_nas: <rs type="work">'dul <lb n="225a5"/> ba mdo rtsa ba</rs>'i tshig don la <abbr>blo gros kyi</abbr> snang ba <abbr>cung zad</abbr> 'chod pa <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4002"><abbr>dge slong blo gros rgyal mtshan</abbr></rs> gyis | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4593"><abbr>dpal ldan</abbr> bla ma</rs>s <abbr>byin gyis</abbr> brlabs <abbr>pa'i</abbr> gdan sa ¦ <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5748">yol rin chen <abbr>gling gi</abbr> gtsug lag khang<anchor xml:id="a1"/> </rs>du <hi rendition="#Time">lnga brgya phrag brgyad pa'i drug bcu re 3 pa: sa mo bya: zhi ba<anchor xml:id="a2"/>'i lo <lb n="225a6"/> dbyar zla ra ba<anchor xml:id="a3"/>'i yar ngo'i tshes 3<anchor xml:id="a4"/> </hi>la zin bris_su bkod pa'o| <abbr>mkhan chen rin po che nas</abbr> 'dis pha mas gtso byas <abbr>pa'i</abbr> <abbr>sems can</abbr> <abbr>thams cad</abbr> kyis <abbr>thams cad</abbr> mkhyen <abbr>pa'i</abbr> go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig | 
            
            yige pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4729">shAkya'i dge slong blo gros seng ge</rs>'o || 

            phyoGS dus gnas <lb n="225a7"/> skabs <abbr>thams cad</abbr> du bkrashis par gyu[r] cig| × <!--lantsa characters--> dge'o ||</seg></TEI>
